column1: # Ash Jenna's two fights: the optional super boss in Vale and the one at Suhalla Gate.

column3: Back in Vale, Isaac.\nStill looking for\nwhat you lost?{end_wait}
This is my home.\nMy mother is here.\nWhy are you?{end_wait}
To see if you can\nprotect what's left.\nDraw your sword.{end_wait}
You've grown stronger.\nIt won't bring back\nwhat you lost.{end_wait}
The guards are down.\nThe ones you chase\nare farther ahead.{end_wait}
No. You want to\nreach them? Then\nget past me.{end_wait}
Go on, then.\nSee how many you\ncan still save.{end_wait}
